name: B10-0060/2024 (ECR) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
This is a resolution, not a law. It sets out the European Parliament's opinion and calls for action after severe floods hit Austria, Czechia, Hungary, Poland, Romania and Slovakia. It asks for money for victims to come as grants that do not have to be paid back, more support for farmers, faster payouts from the EU Solidarity Fund, and more spending on flood defences such as dams. It also praises rescue workers and volunteers.

- It asks for non-repayable aid, farm support and faster Solidarity Fund payouts for flood-hit regions.
- It affects flood victims, farmers and rescue services in six central and eastern European countries.
- Next, the Commission and member states are asked to act; the Parliament cannot pass laws alone.
